item.description:
A prettier welcome

The installer now greets you with Carpet's blue-sky look — clouds and all — to match the app. No functional changes; just a nicer first impression.

Say hello to Carpet

Aura is now Carpet — same quiet little vault that lives in your notch, with a fresh name, a new app icon, and a new wordmark at the top of the library.

Nothing moves: all of your saved items, settings, and reminders are exactly where you left them. This update just changes the look and the name.

Bring your bookmarks

Already have hundreds of links saved in your browser? Export them as HTML (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge — they all do it) and pull the whole lot into Aura from Settings → Import bookmarks. Each becomes a saved link, deduplicated against what you already have, with its preview fetched in the background — and they land right on top, ready to search.

Little touches

  • A quick confirmation toast after an import.
  • Inline “How do I export?” and “What's included?” helpers in Settings.

A proper welcome

First launch now greets you with a quick walkthrough — the logo animates in, you can set your name and turn on notifications, then a short carousel shows how Aura works: copy to nudge, ⌥⌘V for your library, ⌃⌘N for a quick note, and drag-to-save.

Reminders, just write them

Write a note like “call mom tomorrow at 6” and Aura reads the time out of it and reminds you — a local notification, no setup. Click it to jump straight to the item.

Notes without the notch

  • When the Library is open, New Note composes right in the window instead of popping the notch.
  • Redesigned Settings, plus you can now export your whole vault.

Logos for every source

Saved items now show the real logo of wherever they came from — any app, not just a handful. Aura recognises the source (Slack, Postman, Wispr Flow, Notion…), finds its logo on the fly, and falls back to the app's own icon when needed. Every logo is cached, so it's instant after the first time.

Cleaner notch

  • Recent tiles drop the corner type icon — just your content and a timestamp, with Copy / Open on hover.
  • The quick-note composer's back button and spacing got a polish.

Under the hood

  • Aura now checks for updates twice a day, so new versions reach you sooner.
